    assert req(port, 'POST', '/health', {})[0] == 405
    time.sleep(0.2)
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/a')[0] == 404
    assert req(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/z')[0] == 204
    assert req(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/z')[0] == 404
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    assert p.wait(timeout=5) == 0, p.stderr.read()

p2, port2 = start()
try:
    assert req(port2, 'GET', '/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys': ['hello world']}
    assert req(port2, 'GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world')[2] == {'key': 'hello world', 'value': 'new'}
finally:
    p2.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    assert p2.wait(timeout=5) == 0, p2.stderr.read()

print('integration checks passed')
tmp.cleanup()

import json, os, signal, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

server = os.path.abspath('server.py')
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.')
data = os.path.join(tmp.name, 'store.json')

def start():
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, server, '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '0', '--data', data], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    line = p.stdout.readline().strip()
    assert line.startswith('LISTENING '), (line, p.stderr.read())
    return p, int(line.split()[1])

def req(port, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    raw = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
    h = dict(headers or {})
    if raw is not None and 'Content-Type' not in h:
        h['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    r = Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}', data=raw, method=method, headers=h)
    try:
        with urlopen(r, timeout=3) as response:
            payload = response.read()
            return response.status, response.headers, None if not payload else json.loads(payload)
    except HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        return e.code, e.headers, None if not payload else json.loads(payload)

def stop(p):
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    p.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.read())

p, port = start()
try:
    status, headers, out = req(port, 'GET', '/health')
    assert (status, out) == (200, {'status': 'ok'})
    assert headers.get_content_type() == 'application/json'
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys': []}
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a%20key', {'value': {'x': [1, True, None]}})[0] == 201
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/a%20key')[2] == {'key': 'a key', 'value': {'x': [1, True, None]}}
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a%20key', {'value': 2})[0] == 200
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/z', {'value': 3})[0] == 201
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys': ['a key', 'z']}
    assert req(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/z')[0] == 204
    assert req(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/z')[0] == 404
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/temp', {'value': 'gone', 'ttl_seconds': 0.15})[0] == 201
    time.sleep(0.25)
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/temp')[0] == 404
    for method, path, body, expected in [
        ('PUT', '/v1/kv/', {'value': 1}, 400),
        ('PUT', '/v1/kv/a%2Fb', {'value': 1}, 400),
        ('PUT', '/v1/kv/x', [], 400),
        ('PUT', '/v1/kv/x', {}, 400),
        ('PUT', '/v1/kv/x', {'value': 1, 'ttl_seconds': 0}, 400),
        ('PUT', '/v1/kv/x', {'value': 1, 'ttl_seconds': float('inf')}, 400),
        ('POST', '/health', None, 405),
        ('GET', '/nope', None, 404),
    ]:
        got = req(port, method, path, body)[0]
        assert got == expected, (method, path, got, expected)
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/x', b'{broken')[0] == 400
    assert req(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/x', b'x' * (1024 * 1024 + 1), {'Content-Type':'application/json'})[0] == 413
finally:
    stop(p)

p, port = start()
try:
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/a%20key')[2] == {'key': 'a key', 'value': 2}
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/temp')[0] == 404
    assert req(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys': ['a key']}
finally:
    stop(p)

with open(data, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    saved = json.load(f)
assert 'temp' not in saved.get('entries', {})
print('integration tests passed')
tmp.cleanup()

    26	class PersistenceError(RuntimeError):
    27	    """Raised when durable state cannot be read or written."""

    30	class Store:
    31	    def __init__(self, data_path: Path) -> None:
    32	        self.data_path = data_path
    33	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
    34	        self._entries: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    35	        self._load()
    36	
    37	    @staticmethod
    38	    def _is_live(entry: dict[str, Any], now: float) -> bool:
    39	        expires_at = entry["expires_at"]
    40	        return expires_at is None or expires_at > now
    41	
    42	    def _load(self) -> None:
    43	        if not self.data_path.exists():
    44	            return
    45	        try:
    46	            with self.data_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    47	                document = json.load(stream, parse_constant=self._reject_constant)
    48	            if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("version") != 1:
    49	                raise ValueError("expected a version 1 object")
    50	            entries = document.get("entries")
    51	            if not isinstance(entries, dict):
    52	                raise ValueError("'entries' must be an object")
    53	
    54	            loaded: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    55	            for key, entry in entries.items():
    56	                if not isinstance(key, str) or not key or "/" in key:
    57	                    raise ValueError("stored key is invalid")
    58	                if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != {"value", "expires_at"}:
    59	                    raise ValueError("stored entry is invalid")
    60	                expires_at = entry["expires_at"]
    61	                if expires_at is not None and (
    62	                    isinstance(expires_at, bool)
    63	                    or not isinstance(expires_at, (int, float))
    64	                    or not math.isfinite(expires_at)
    65	                ):
    66	                    raise ValueError("stored expiration is invalid")
    67	                loaded[key] = {"value": entry["value"], "expires_at": expires_at}
    68	        except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
    69	            raise PersistenceError(f"cannot load data file {self.data_path}: {exc}") from exc
    70	
    71	        now = time.time()
    72	        self._entries = {
    73	            key: entry for key, entry in loaded.items() if self._is_live(entry, now)
    74	        }
    75	        if len(self._entries) != len(loaded):
    76	            self._persist_locked()

    78	    @staticmethod
    79	    def _reject_constant(value: str) -> None:
    80	        raise ValueError(f"invalid JSON constant {value}")
    81	
    82	    def _persist_locked(self) -> None:
    83	        parent = self.data_path.parent
    84	        try:
    85	            parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    86	            fd, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
    87	                prefix=f".{self.data_path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=parent
    88	            )
    89	            try:
    90	                with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    91	                    json.dump(
    92	                        {"version": 1, "entries": self._entries},
    93	                        stream,
    94	                        ensure_ascii=False,
    95	                        separators=(",", ":"),
    96	                        allow_nan=False,
    97	                    )
    98	                    stream.write("\n")
    99	                    stream.flush()
   100	                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
   101	                os.replace(temporary_name, self.data_path)
   102	                try:
   103	                    directory_fd = os.open(parent, os.O_RDONLY)
   104	                    try:
   105	                        os.fsync(directory_fd)
   106	                    finally:
   107	                        os.close(directory_fd)
   108	                except OSError:
   109	                    # The replacement itself is atomic; not every platform permits
   110	                    # fsync on a directory.
   111	                    pass
   112	            except BaseException:
   113	                try:
   114	                    os.unlink(temporary_name)
   115	                except FileNotFoundError:
   116	                    pass
   117	                raise
   118	        except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   119	            raise PersistenceError(f"cannot persist data file {self.data_path}: {exc}") from exc
   120	
   121	    def _remove_expired_locked(self, now: float) -> bool:
   122	        expired = [
   123	            key for key, entry in self._entries.items() if not self._is_live(entry, now)
   124	        ]
   125	        for key in expired:
   126	            del self._entries[key]
   127	        if expired:
   128	            self._persist_locked()
   129	        return bool(expired)

   131	    def put(self, key: str, value: Any, ttl_seconds: int | float | None) -> bool:
   132	        with self._lock:
   133	            now = time.time()
   134	            old_entry = self._entries.get(key)
   135	            created = old_entry is None or not self._is_live(old_entry, now)
   136	            new_entry = {
   137	                "value": value,
   138	                "expires_at": None if ttl_seconds is None else now + ttl_seconds,
   139	            }
   140	            self._entries[key] = new_entry
   141	            try:
   142	                self._persist_locked()
   143	            except PersistenceError:
   144	                if old_entry is None:
   145	                    del self._entries[key]
   146	                else:
   147	                    self._entries[key] = old_entry
   148	                raise
   149	            return created
   150	
   151	    def get(self, key: str) -> tuple[bool, Any]:
   152	        with self._lock:
   153	            entry = self._entries.get(key)
   154	            if entry is None:
   155	                return False, None
   156	            if not self._is_live(entry, time.time()):
   157	                del self._entries[key]
   158	                self._persist_locked()
   159	                return False, None
   160	            return True, entry["value"]
   161	
   162	    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
   163	        with self._lock:
   164	            entry = self._entries.get(key)
   165	            if entry is None:
   166	                return False
   167	            if not self._is_live(entry, time.time()):
   168	                del self._entries[key]
   169	                self._persist_locked()
   170	                return False
   171	            del self._entries[key]
   172	            try:
   173	                self._persist_locked()
   174	            except PersistenceError:
   175	                self._entries[key] = entry
   176	                raise
   177	            return True
   178	
   179	    def keys(self) -> list[str]:
   180	        with self._lock:
   181	            self._remove_expired_locked(time.time())
   182	            return sorted(self._entries)

   205	    def _send_json(self, status: int, body: Any) -> None:

   210	        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")

   229	    def _path(self) -> str | None:

   240	    def _key_from_path(self, path: str) -> str | None:

   246	            self._error(400, "invalid key encoding")

   248	        try:
   249	            raw_key = unquote_to_bytes(encoded_key)
   250	            key = raw_key.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")
   251	        except (UnicodeEncodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
   252	            self._error(400, "key must be valid UTF-8")
   253	            return ""
   254	        if not key or "/" in key:
   255	            self._error(400, "key must be non-empty and must not contain '/'")
   256	            return ""
   257	        return key
   258	
   259	    def _read_json_body(self) -> Any:
   260	        content_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
   261	        if content_length is None:
   262	            raise RequestProblem(411, "Content-Length is required")
   263	        try:
   264	            length = int(content_length, 10)
   265	        except ValueError as exc:
   266	            raise RequestProblem(400, "invalid Content-Length") from exc
   267	        if length < 0:
   268	            raise RequestProblem(400, "invalid Content-Length")
   269	        if length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
   270	            self.close_connection = True
   271	            raise RequestProblem(413, "request body exceeds 1 MiB")
   272	        media_type = self.headers.get_content_type()
   273	        if media_type != "application/json":
   274	            raise RequestProblem(415, "Content-Type must be application/json")
   275	        try:
   276	            raw_body = self.rfile.read(length)
   277	        except (OSError, TimeoutError) as exc:
   278	            raise RequestProblem(400, "could not read request body") from exc
   279	        if len(raw_body) != length:
   280	            raise RequestProblem(400, "incomplete request body")
   281	        try:
   282	            return json.loads(raw_body, parse_constant=Store._reject_constant)
   283	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
   284	            raise RequestProblem(400, "malformed JSON") from exc
   285	
   286	    def do_GET(self) -> None:
   287	        path = self._path()
   288	        if path is None:
   289	            return
   290	        try:
   291	            if path == "/health":
   292	                self._send_json(200, {"status": "ok"})
   293	                return
   294	            if path == "/v1/keys":
   295	                self._send_json(200, {"keys": self.server.store.keys()})
   296	                return
   297	            key = self._key_from_path(path)
   298	            if key is None:
   299	                self._error(404, "route not found")
   300	            elif key:
   301	                found, value = self.server.store.get(key)
   302	                if found:
   303	                    self._send_json(200, {"key": key, "value": value})
   304	                else:
   305	                    self._error(404, "key not found")
   306	        except PersistenceError as exc:
   307	            self.log_error("%s", exc)
   308	            self._error(500, "persistence failure")
   309	
   310	    def do_PUT(self) -> None:
   311	        path = self._path()
   312	        if path is None:
   313	            return
   314	        key = self._key_from_path(path)
   315	        if key is None:
   316	            self._error(404, "route not found")
   317	            return
   318	        if not key:
   319	            return
   320	        try:
   321	            body = self._read_json_body()
   322	            if not isinstance(body, dict) or isinstance(body, bool):
   323	                raise RequestProblem(400, "body must be a JSON object")
   324	            if "value" not in body or not set(body).issubset({"value", "ttl_seconds"}):
   325	                raise RequestProblem(
   326	                    400, "body must contain 'value' and optional 'ttl_seconds' only"
   327	                )
   328	            ttl = body.get("ttl_seconds")
   329	            if ttl is not None and (
   330	                isinstance(ttl, bool)
   331	                or not isinstance(ttl, (int, float))
   332	                or not math.isfinite(ttl)
   333	                or ttl <= 0
   334	            ):
   335	                raise RequestProblem(400, "ttl_seconds must be finite and greater than zero")
   336	            created = self.server.store.put(key, body["value"], ttl)
   337	            self._send_json(201 if created else 200, {"key": key, "value": body["value"]})
   338	        except RequestProblem as exc:
   339	            self._error(exc.status, exc.message)
   340	        except PersistenceError as exc:
   341	            self.log_error("%s", exc)
   342	            self._error(500, "persistence failure")
   343	
   344	    def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
   345	        path = self._path()
   346	        if path is None:
   347	            return
   348	        key = self._key_from_path(path)
   349	        if key is None:
   350	            self._error(404, "route not found")
   351	            return
   352	        if not key:
   353	            return
   354	        try:
   355	            if self.server.store.delete(key):

   358	                self.end_headers()
   359	            else:
   360	                self._error(404, "key not found")
   361	        except PersistenceError as exc:
   362	            self.log_error("%s", exc)
   363	            self._error(500, "persistence failure")

   366	        self._error(405, "method not allowed")

   371	    do_OPTIONS = _method_not_allowed
   372	    do_TRACE = _method_not_allowed
   373	    do_CONNECT = _method_not_allowed

   376	class RequestProblem(Exception):

   379	        self.status = status
   380	        self.message = message

   383	def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
   384	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

   387	    parser.add_argument("--data", required=True, type=Path, help="JSON data file")

   399	    except (OSError, PersistenceError) as exc:

   403	    stopping = threading.Event()

   406	        del signum, frame

   409	            threading.Thread(target=server.shutdown, daemon=True).start()

   412	    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, request_shutdown)
